history.summary: A $1.728M 1BR at Grand Dunman (12 Dunman Road), a 99LH mega-project in D15, asking a steep $2,434 psf for a 710 sqft one-bedder. The price is new-launch level for a niche unit type with weak yield and no appreciation track record yet.
history.rating_rationale: $2,434 psf and a $1.728M ticket for a 1BR is very rich — that's larger-2BR money for the smallest, most rental-dependent unit type. No URA appreciation/txn data (built_year null, fallback dossier), weak Elo (814, 80-235 record) and score_1000 466. Exit pool for a $1.7M one-bedder is narrow; the development is fine but this stack/price is overpriced for investment.
red_flags: $2,434 psf is steep new-launch pricing for a 1BR
$1.728M for a 1-bedder pushes well past the niche tenant/buyer pool
No URA appreciation or transaction data to support price; missing built_year
catalysts: Prime D15 East Coast location with deep overall buyer demand
Large well-amenitised development (Grand Dunman) near Dakota MRT and future supply
